title: CSAF Games Library: All 46 Paid Games, Plus Every New One
shortText: 46 paid games for $14.99: every paid game in the CSAF games line, plus each new one on launch day.
description:
Every paid game from the CSAF games line in one place: 46 games for one price of $14.99. The 42 still sold on their own pages list for $310.58 bought one by one. Every new paid game from the line joins at no extra cost on its launch day.

How the future games work

  • Every new paid game the studio publishes on csaf.itch.io joins this Library on its launch day, for as long as the studio publishes games, except THE KEPT YEAR. Collections, bundles, soundtracks and asset packs are not games and are not added.
  • You don't pay again. Open the Library's download page (from your itch library or your purchase email) and the new game's file is there.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

THE KEPT YEAR, the studio's long JRPG in development, will be sold on its own page and is not part of this Library.

Latest additions

2026-11-10: LAMPBLACK, a stealth game of five night heists for Windows, joined in its own download. 2026-11-07: LIVEWIRE, a cyberpunk courier action game for Windows, joined the same way. Neither has a page of its own yet (pages with free browser demos are planned), so both are sold only here for now.

2026-11-07: FESTOON's page became the CSAF Game Boy Library; FESTOON stays here.

2026-11-06: the Library opened with 44 games.

What is inside (46 games)

Action and adventure (12): HOLLOWAY, BOLTHOLE, SIDELONG, GUISER, AUGUR, CRYPTMARCH, WINTERING, TINDERBOX, BONEFOLD, LIVEWIRE, LAMPBLACK, DOWNBEAT.

RPGs and story games (6): MOONWORT, HEADGATE, LANTERNBOUND, CAIRNWAKE, THE LONG DEFEAT, THE BRASS ORRERY.

Mystery, deduction and exploration (6): PLUMBLINE, LINGUIST OF THE DEEP, THE TURNING YEAR, STRINGLINE, DOWSER, ONE ROOM DREAD.

Cozy puzzles and sims (9): GLASSWRIGHT, LODESTONE, NIGHT PLOUGH, ROOTWORK, MILLWRIGHT, STRAYWOOD, PILOTAGE, HALTER, NOCTUARY.

Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges (13): ANATOMIST, PROOFMARK, WITNESS MARK, WARDLOCK, SOUNDER, CRAQUELURE, ROSE ENGINE, SCRUPLE, COMPOSITOR, CUTBANK, ANATOMIST II, WISPCATCHER, FESTOON.

Every other name links to the game's own page, with its screenshots and, for most, a free browser demo. DOWNBEAT's page became this Library, so it is sold only here. LIVEWIRE and LAMPBLACK have no page yet (see Latest additions). Every game still sold on its own page is the same file that page sells. DOWNBEAT and FESTOON are the builds their pages sold before those pages became Libraries.

The Game Boy download also holds the POCKET ANTHOLOGY set: six of the Game Boy games in this download in one set, with an offline browser player for their free demos and WARDLOCK's printable manual. It is not counted as a separate game.

The downloads

9 downloads, grouped so you only get what you want to play:

  • Action and adventure, part 1: 5 games, about 518 MB
  • Action and adventure, part 2: 4 games, about 598 MB
  • RPGs and story games: 6 games, about 542 MB
  • Mystery, deduction and exploration: 6 games, about 539 MB
  • Cozy puzzles and sims: 9 games, about 797 MB
  • Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges: 13 games, about 11 MB
  • LIVEWIRE, added 2026-11-07: 1 game, about 147 MB
  • LAMPBLACK, added 2026-11-10: 1 game, about 145 MB
  • DOWNBEAT for Windows, about 146 MB

The 32 desktop games are Windows builds: unzip and run the .exe, nothing to install. Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time; choose More info, then Run anyway.

The 13 Game Boy games are .gb ROM files for a Game Boy emulator. They were tested in an emulator, not on real hardware: other emulators (for example mGBA, SameBoy or Emulicious) and flash cartridges should work but were not tested. CRAQUELURE and FESTOON need a Game Boy Color or a Game Boy Color emulator. All 13 are also sold together as the CSAF Game Boy Library ($9.99): https://csaf.itch.io/game-boy-library

On a Mac or Linux machine 15 of the 46 play: the 13 Game Boy games in an emulator and AUGUR and HALTER in a web browser (the catalogue gives the path). The other 31 are Windows only.

Free CSAF games

CSAF's free games are outside the Library: the 6 free games from this line (WICKLIGHT, ANTIPOLE, BANNERET, SKEIN, SNOWBANK, LAST CART OUT) and the free browser arcade games at csaf.itch.io.

Licence and how it was made

Play every game on computers you own or use, keep backups, and record, stream and share videos and screenshots. Don't redistribute, resell or rehost the games, or reuse their art and audio. A game's own LICENSE.txt governs it where it has one; the Library licence covers the rest.

Made with AI: these games were made with AI. Their code and writing were made with AI (Claude), and their art was made with AI, mostly from our own asset packs made with AI. Their music was written by AI as note sequences and is played by our own synthesis code or rendered through a licensed soundfont; no generative audio model was used. Some store covers are pictures made by an image model.

The price

$14.99, bought once. Anyone who owns the Library keeps every game that joins it, at no extra cost.

Questions go in the comments below. A rating is the best way to support the Library.

Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
